title: Orders
description: The orders that take material out of a warehouse: they reserve it when created, are picked and validated.

form.chooseWarehouse: Choose the warehouse first: its availability will show here.

lineErrors.QUANTITY_INVALID: The quantity must be greater than zero.
lineErrors.STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: The warehouse does not have that much available.

assignDialog.title: Assign the order
assignDialog.noStaff: The warehouse has no operators in its staff template.

validateDialog.title: Validate the order
validateDialog.body: The order is locked: its receipt is stored and it can no longer change.
validateDialog.noteHint: Write it if something does not match what was picked.

differenceDialog.title: Accept the difference
differenceDialog.body: Every line becomes what was picked, as in material entries, and the order can be validated.
differenceDialog.noteHint: Explain why the customer accepts the difference.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the order
cancelDialog.body: The reservation is released and the order cannot be reopened.

reassignDialog.title: Change the operator
reassignDialog.body: The lines, the picked material and the reservation stay with the order.

transferDialog.title: Move picked material to another order
transferDialog.body: The material already left its locations: it now serves the target order and no balance changes.
transferDialog.noTargets: There is no other open order in this warehouse.
transferDialog.noteHint: Why it moves to the other order.
transferDialog.abovePicked: That is more than the line has picked.
transferDialog.aboveTarget: The target order does not need that much.

returnDialog.title: Return picked material to the floor
returnDialog.body: The material goes back into a location of the warehouse, with a movement in.
returnDialog.noteHint: Why it goes back to the floor.
